```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import json

with open("../people/people.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

people = pd.json_normalize(data)
print(f"عدد السجلات: {len(people)}")
print(list(people.columns))
people.head()
```

## الشخصيات حسب العصر

```{python}
#| echo: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

counts = people["period"].value_counts().head(10)
counts.plot(kind="barh")
plt.xlabel("عدد الشخصيات")
plt.gca().invert_yaxis()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
